about: Search ranking and board rules, shared by the TypeScript tests (packages/core) and the Kotlin commonTest (apps/mobile). Titles default to type movie. "refine" reveals one catalog (addon rank 0) and lists what passes the cutoffs, top match included, in rank order. Years are judged against currentYear.
